properties.statement: Wrote a Python script, five times in one day, that maps the files a branch changed (git diff --name-only against main) to registered Artifact ids by their `location` in the committed export, hashes each, and prints the observation list — the input set_artifact_checksums needs after a code change. reflow2_check.py does the hash-and-reconcile pass for the gate, but nothing served answers "which registered artifacts did MY branch touch, with their new hashes" for the acceptance step; reconcile_artifacts takes the observations and computes none.
